hook: Students photocopied this Unix book for twenty years.

beats.say: John Lions wrote a commentary on the Unix Version 6 source code, and by 1977 his notes were circulating among schools and research institutions with Unix licenses.
Even Bell Labs wanted copies, and eventually took over distribution. But for roughly twenty years before the official edition appeared, students studied from unauthorized photocopies.
The book helped a generation of students learn to build operating systems of their own, and the official edition finally appeared in 1996.
